❓ Frequently asked questions

When does overtime apply?

In the US, the FLSA requires 1.5× pay for hours over 40 in a workweek for non-exempt workers. Some states add daily overtime rules.

What is double time?

2× the regular rate, required in some states (e.g. California for hours over 12 in a day) or by union contracts.

Is overtime taxed differently?

No — it is taxed as ordinary income. Withholding may look higher on a big check, but the tax rate is the same.
